bodyDescription: The Jackers mix are delicious biscuits suitable for all dog breeds. These crispy biscuits are very tasty and can be given during training as a reward or simply as a snack to spoil your four-legged friend. Extra plus: all our biscuits are enriched with vitamins A, D3 and E !
